packageRules.description: Third-party GitHub Actions updates are grouped into one PR, pinned to commit digests, and wait three days after release; then Renovate automerges them once the required checks pass. The hive also merges mergeraptor[bot] PRs once the required checks pass, because it is a trusted bot.
First-party projectbluefin/** actions open at any time and Renovate automerges them as soon as the required checks pass. The hive also merges mergeraptor[bot] PRs once the required checks pass.

Go module and Go toolchain non-major updates are grouped into one PR, tidied with go mod tidy, and wait three days after release; then Renovate automerges them once the required checks pass. The hive also merges mergeraptor[bot] PRs once the required checks pass, because it is a trusted bot.
Renovate never automerges GitHub Actions or Go module majors. The hive's trusted-bot merge policy is independent of this setting: it still merges mergeraptor[bot] PRs once the required checks pass.
